page.overview:
Who is Bat Bugs?

Bat Bugs are flying creatures who make their first appearance in the episode "Evicted!" They cover the walls of Marceline's cave, leading Finn and Jake to mistakenly believe the cave is dirty. When Finn and Jake enter the cave, the Bat Bugs fly away, revealing a clean, glittering cave. They also appear in Level 2 of Righteous Quest, and in Fionna Fights! They are also available as an overlay in MiXiT Video Creator, wherein they are called "Adventure Time bats".

Bat bugs appear to be bugs with wings similar to bats. They have various shapes and sizes. Their skin is colored green, while their eyes are blue in color.
